scope_summary: Imported candidate for Vector Mechanics & Resolving Components. No authority is carried; every gap below must be authored before this can be admitted.

microtopics.title: Vector Mechanics & Resolving Components
entry_assumptions: **Vector Addition Commutativity & Parallelogram Law**: Vectors add geometrically ($\vec{A} + \vec{B} = \vec{B} + \vec{A}$). The magnitude of resultant is $R = \sqrt{A^2 + B^2 + 2AB\cos\theta}$. Scalars and vectors cannot be added together.

**Coordinate Invariance of Dot and Cross Products**: The dot product $\vec{A} \cdot \vec{B} = A B \cos\theta$ is a coordinate-invariant scalar. The cross product $\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = A B \sin\theta\,\hat{n}$ is an axial vector perpendicular to both $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$.
microtopics.inferential_jump: Vector representation: magnitude and direction; unit vector $\hat{a} = \frac{\vec{A}}{|\vec{A}|}$.

teaching_path.action: Evaluating cross product via determinant: $\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ A_x & A_y & A_z \\ B_x & B_y & B_z \end{vmatrix}$.
Choosing rotated coordinate axes aligned with constraints (such as ramp inclination) to decouple equations of motion.

misconceptions.repair: Cross product is anti-commutative: $\vec{A} \times \vec{B} = -(\vec{B} \times \vec{A})$. Reversing operand order flips the normal vector direction.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: Attempting to compute $\frac{\vec{A}}{\vec{B}}$ to find a vector.
misconceptions.repair: Division by a vector is undefined because multiple vectors can produce the same dot or cross product result.
